notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
Barrenton Medic does not have more than two -1/-1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it, preventing the next one damage done to it this turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Barrenton Medic ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.
